component.name: PCOC Hike
component.summary: Produce, verify and sign in with SDK 2.3 objects

description.p: PCOC Hike checks kind v2.2-pcoc-object with the in-tree Rust SDK (sdk/rust). It shows the section 14 record, and submits one groundinglab sign-in. Start hike reads live headers and posts waypoints.
An nsec is pasted or generated for the session. It stays in memory and is never written. The npub is derived from it.
Start hike runs a live producer. Stop cancels the hike and writes no object.
Aligns the app to SPEC 2.3 and Rust SDK v2.3.0. Object kind stays v2.2-pcoc-object.
Send to my phone: a finished PCOC goes to its own npub as one encrypted Nostr message (NIP-04), for the phone app signed in with that npub.
Flatpak packaging is in this repository; the published bundle is built from this tag.
The desktop app includes the Rust SDK in-process.
Produce, verify, and sign in. The nsec stays in memory.
